parts.name: Cabinet Door (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: This is the upper cabinet door made of MDF, part of a storage cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It covers and protects the upper storage compartment, allowing access when opened.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: This is the lower cabinet door made of MDF, part of a storage cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It covers and protects the lower storage compartment, allowing access when opened.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Shelf (Middle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the middle shelf made of plywood, used inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and divides the internal space into sections.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: This is the upper shelf made of plywood, located inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for storing items within the upper compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame of the cabinet made of solid wood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the doors and shelves.
parts.Movement_description: It is stationary and does not move.

parts.name: Shelf (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: This is the lower shelf made of plywood, located inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items in the lower compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.
